title: iPhone 18 Pro Max: Launch date, design, camera upgrades, AI features & everything Apple could unveil
desc: iPhone 18 Pro Max: Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in September 2026. According to reports, the devices are likely to feature Apple's new A20 chip, offering faster performance and improved power efficiency. Significant camera upgrades are also expected, including enhancements to low-light photography and overall image quality. Battery life could improve further through a combination of larger batteries and the more efficient chipset. Reports also suggest Apple may increase the prices of the Pro models by up to $200, although the company has not officially confirmed any details.
